title: HissTickBoom [BNB Standalone #2]
description: Makes Creepers even more painful to deal with!
body:
This mod is a standalone from another mod of mine thats in a WIP phase, BuildsNBarrens.
_______________________________________________________________________________________________

Okay, creepers, right? The awful things that blow up your stuff?
  Yeah, I've made them even more awful!
_______________________________________________________________________________________________

This mod adds 4 main things to the creeper lineage:

Rependare - 
    Basically a creepery, moss-ish blockset. Creepers now spread patches of rependare upon 
  exploding, along with its reproductive ascus which is simply named "violent ascus" due to it 
  forming a new creeper or charger upon being exploded, furthering the spread of creeper holes 
  and making everything so much worse!
    Bringing a bow in caves or nighttime expeditions is very reccomended so you can deal with 
  creepers from a distance.

Chargers - 
    A rependare formation that resembles the common creeper you know and despise... If it was a 
  gamer and was hit in the face with a frying pan- 
    Instead of exploding their targets directly, these gremlins decided that using small 
  explosions to chuck themselves at the aggressor - knocking them backwards in what is 
  essentially an overly violent faceplant - was a better idea.

Channelers - 
    These curlier formations had been modified a long, long time ago, early geomancers 
  experimented with rependare to create an explosionless form to test it other properties 
  safely, later deciding to shove a lightning rod through its shaggy skull to test 
  conductivity... 
    They don't talk about what happened next- Either way, they now spread charge to their 
  explosion-prone buddies, coming out of hiding during rain and thunder! YAY!

Creeper Woods - 
    Small spruce banks and shores holding a concentrated abundance of rependare, instead of   
  small residues in the dirt and stone. Patches of rependare cover the floor, along with 
  exposed violent ascus...

Have fun!
